purpose.datastore.entities.list: Find this server's school membership, entitlement and invoice records in transactions.
purpose.datastore.entities.update: Record invoice reconciliation, paid intervals, entitlement projections and idempotent processing state.
purpose.firebaseauth.users.get: Verify the authenticated test user's registration, verification and disabled state server-side.

scopeLimitation: Cloud IAM applies to this Stage project, not individual Firestore documents. Application authorization additionally limits the closed pilot to explicitly permitted UIDs and owned billing records.
activationGates: Independent payment/source-preservation review and important fixes verified
Explicit permission for the three additional Stage service rights
Source coverage for all preview writing and generation endpoints; older prototype routes must not silently bypass enrolled-user limits
Target-preserving artifacts, current generation hashes and rollback manifest verified before deployment
Own preview and protected runtime paths deployed before allowedUids/payments.ready activation
